problem: Append-only recovery claim paths permit multiple simultaneous recovery attempts for the same stale lineage because each attempt uses a unique filename and active recovery overlap is caller-supplied rather than atomically pinned. During this /wc run, one stale kernel recovery had only the 09:06 attempt when first inspected; by the next collision refresh, three additional recovery claims had appeared around 09:51-09:52 for the same opportunity before a single winner was established.
acceptance: A deterministic recovery-lineage identity maps all attempts for the same stale opportunity/run lineage to one create-if-absent pin.
Concurrent recovery claim attempts yield exactly one winner; losers preserve evidence and do not start substantive writes.
Late original or recovery returns remain preserved and reconciled without newest-wins promotion.
Tests cover 2-worker and 5-worker recovery races plus pin release/supersession rules without granting Current, Human Accepted, or Served authority.
title: Make stale recovery single-winner by lineage
mission: Implement and canary an atomic recovery-lineage pin that sits before append-only recovery claim/run creation. Derive a deterministic identity from opportunity + stale run/attempt lineage, use create-if-absent host semantics so only one recovery worker may enter substantive recovery for that lineage, emit durable loser/collision evidence, preserve all original/late returns, and define explicit supersession/release rules without authority promotion.

unblock_value.reason: Recovery is intended to prevent vanished workers from becoming gates; duplicate recovery workers reintroduce collisions exactly at that safety path.

incident_repair.reason: The live kernel stale-recovery lane produced multiple near-simultaneous recovery claims for the same opportunity/lineage, demonstrating that append-only attempt filenames are not an exclusivity primitive.

regression_prevention.reason: The current lease library evaluates caller-supplied active_overlap but does not itself atomically establish a single recovery winner, so the same race can recur on every stale opportunity.

human_friction_reduction.reason: A deterministic recovery winner removes the need for a human or parent to arbitrate duplicate rescue chats after the fact.

falsification: Two recovery workers for the same stale lineage can both acquire permission to enter substantive recovery.
Five concurrent attempts create more than one winning lineage pin or any loser overwrites the winner.
A recovery-lineage pin causes original claims/runs/returns or late returns to be erased or silently discarded.
Pin release or supersession permits an overlapping active recovery writer without explicit terminal/stale evidence.
The mechanism grants or implies Current, Human Accepted, Served, or integration authority.
dedup_note: This is narrower than the completed lease/retry primitive, which intentionally leaves recovery persistence to a separately authorized executor and takes active_overlap as input. It is also distinct from the generic claim-race canary and discovery proposal pin canary: the observed defect is recovery-specific exclusivity over one stale lineage after eligibility has already been established.
